title: Subtracting Tens and Ones Within 100
description: Subtract tens and ones within 100 without regrouping by crossing out base-ten models and counting what remains.
learningFocus: Subtract multiples of 10 and subtract tens and ones within 100 without regrouping by using place-value models and reasoning about tens and ones.
adultGuidance: Ask your child to name the starting tens and ones, cross out only the amount being subtracted, and count what remains. Encourage explanations such as “I subtracted tens from tens and ones from ones”; these pages intentionally avoid regrouping so the place-value relationship stays visible.
